summary: Iteration 15 - Enterprise Data Engine testing. Created /app/backend/tests/test_enterprise_data_engine.py with 21 backend tests (all passing). Fixed 2 route-ordering bugs discovered during testing (GET /api/datasources/supported-types and GET /api/metadata/jobs were being shadowed by dynamic path routes and returned 404). Frontend Data Engine page verified end-to-end: 6 tabs, add-datasource dialog with all 8 fields, query engine controls, glossary dialog, Jobs & Cache showing Redis connected + memory + keys, back-to-dashboard nav, and data-engine-button in UserDashboard navbar.

minor.issue: DialogContent aria-describedby warning in console (accessibility warning only, not functional)

action_items: None - all fixes applied. Optional: add Description/aria-describedby to DialogContent components (add-datasource-dialog, glossary-dialog) to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Route ordering bug in /app/backend/routes/datasource_connect_routes.py — GET /supported-types was declared AFTER GET /{ds_id}, causing supported-types requests to be captured by the dynamic path handler and return 404 'Datasource not found'. Moved /supported-types (and /) before /{ds_id} and removed duplicate.

FIXED: Route ordering bug in /app/backend/routes/metadata_routes.py — GET /jobs and GET /jobs/{job_id} were declared AFTER GET /{datasource_id}, so /jobs was being matched by the dynamic route (datasource_id='jobs') returning 404 'No metadata found. Run a scan first.'. Moved job routes above /{datasource_id}.
SQL validator correctly rejects DROP/DELETE/INSERT/UPDATE/TRUNCATE/ALTER/CREATE/GRANT/REVOKE/EXEC/MERGE via regex word-boundary matching and only allows SELECT / WITH prefixes.
Redis cache stats endpoint public (no auth) as documented; returns connected:true, keys_count, used_memory_human.
Glossary CRUD correctly excludes MongoDB _id, uses UUID id, and properly scopes queries by user_id.
Datasource connect endpoint properly validates db_type (returns 400 with 'Unsupported' message) and returns 400 'Connection failed:' when host is unreachable.
Datasource list endpoint strips password from connection dict before returning.
Consider adding rate limiting on /api/query/validate since it is public/unauthenticated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 tabs, dialogs, controls, and navigation verified)

seed_data_creation: Glossary CRUD tests create TEST_MRR and TEST_to_delete terms and clean them up via fixture teardown / delete flow.

rca_of_the_issue: Two /404 bugs on /api/datasources/supported-types and /api/metadata/jobs were caused by FastAPI route ordering — dynamic path routes /{ds_id} and /{datasource_id} were registered before the static routes, so FastAPI's first-match router captured 'supported-types' and 'jobs' as path params. Fix: move static routes above dynamic path-param routes. Reproduction: GET /api/datasources/supported-types with Bearer token → 404 'Datasource not found'. After fix: 200 with {'types':['postgresql','mysql']}.
